ZWE.note: A planned hospital-to-Civil-Registry notification system is announced without a date, and the document does not identify NPRA as the national ID system.
The document states no digital birth or death registration in service, procured or piloted.
No online government service portal is named; the traffic system is one agency's enforcement system.
Voter registration is mentioned only as a service the planned notification system would support.
The document states no ID number given at birth, only an intention that hospital births flow to the registry systems.
Identity verification is named only as a process interconnected systems would enable; no service is described.
